The correct expression should be `(bit & (1 << i)) != 0`, which checks if the i-th bit is set in the bitmask. This ensures that the correct subset of stands is evaluated for each combination. Additionally, the specification should clarify that the function reads input directly from standard input and does not use command-line arguments.
